meta.topStoryHeadline: New York City Doubles Individual Artist Grants to $10,000
meta.topStorySummary: City-funded grants for individual artists can now reach $10,000, twice the previous maximum. Applications run through borough partners, with Brooklyn’s deadline approaching October 11.
executiveSummary: New York City raises the maximum individual artist grant to $10,000, with Brooklyn applications due October 11 and other borough deadlines following in October and November.

Tayari Jones and Elizabeth Acevedo win Kirkus Prizes; Edwidge Danticat and Camonghne Felix become National Book Award finalists. Dance Magazine announces honorees including Germaine Acogny, Ayodele Casel, Cleo Parker Robinson, and Alice Sheppard.

Whitney workers ratify a contract and avert a strike, following agreements at Brooklyn Museum and American Folk Art Museum. CENTRO’s archival exhibition, Arthur Jafa’s New Museum survey, and Roger Guenveur Smith’s extended Basquiat tribute round out the highlights.
